author: The Current
description:
"Protesting and partying are not mutually exclusive," says Low Cut Connie's Adam Weiner
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Low Cut Connie's 2026 album, "Livin' in the USA," contains plenty of socially conscious food for thought. It also features the single, "Can't Be Wrong," one of the year's definitive feelgood songs. 

In an interview with The Current's Jill Riley, Low Cut Connie frontman talks about how socially conscious and feelgood music can coexist side by side. "Protesting and partying are not mutually exclusive," he says. Hear more from Adam Weiner in the video above. 

Low Cut Connie headline at First Avenue in Minneapolis on Thursday, Nov. 12. Find more information at The Current's Gig List: https://www.thecurrent.org/events/20261112-the-gig-list-low-cut-connie
